asset.name: GlobalCommandSystem
asset.description: The command infrastructure combining registry, palette, shortcut hints, menu surfacing, scope and availability, argument prompting, execution, and history.

requires.reason: Registrations are shared across every consuming surface.
Key bindings resolve through one collision-aware registry.
The palette is the visible front end of the registry.

rationale: Built as infrastructure rather than a modal so one registration drives the palette, menus, toolbars, shortcut hints, and agent-invoked actions. Separate command lists per surface is how shortcuts silently diverge from menus.
